feature_definitions.allocation_present: one when at least one allocation exists in the interval
feature_definitions.entry_count/exit_count: session starts/ends in the five-minute interval
feature_definitions.hour_sin/hour_cos: cyclic local-clock position; timestamps are UTC
feature_definitions.mean_walking_distance/mean_congestion/me: mean normalized allocation component, or zero without allocations
feature_definitions.next_occupancy_ratio: occupancy ratio in the next five-minute interval; last row has no future target
feature_definitions.occupancy_change: current occupancy ratio minus previous interval ratio
feature_definitions.occupancy_mean_15m: mean occupancy ratio over the last three intervals
feature_definitions.occupancy_mean_60m: mean occupancy ratio over the last twelve intervals
feature_definitions.occupancy_ratio: occupied slots divided by configured capacity
feature_definitions.returning_vehicle_rate: share of interval entries by previously observed vehicles
feature_definitions.unique_vehicle_count: distinct simulated vehicles represented by sessions in the interval

limitations: All values are simulated. The generator models five configured slots and does not represent measured site demand, actual weather, camera accuracy, or physical throughput.
origin: prediction.demo_data deterministic generator; no real-world measurements

preprocessing.continuous_features: standardized using training partition statistics only
preprocessing.missing_values: short gaps carried forward by existing feature builder; longer gaps remain missing and are excluded from examples
preprocessing.split: chronological 70% train / 15% validation / 15% test before window construction

privacy: No RFID UID, vehicle ID, session ID, idempotency key, or secret is exported.
reproduction: Run `make review-dataset` from the repository root.
